title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases concerning Mediation and Arbitration of Rural Land Contract Management Disputes

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where the rural land contract arbitration committee, in accordance with Article 18 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Mediation and Arbitration of Rural Land Contract Disputes, rejects an application on the ground that the limitation period for applying for arbitration has expired, and a party subsequently initiates an action with respect to the same dispute, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Article 2 Where a party initiates an action with the People's Court with respect to the same dispute after thirty days from the date of receipt of the arbitration award made by the rural land contract arbitration committee, or after signing to receive the mediation document made by the rural land contract arbitration committee, the court shall rule that the action is not accepted; if the action has already been accepted, the court shall rule to dismiss the prosecution.

Article 3 Where a party initiates an action with the People's Court within thirty days from the date of receipt of the arbitration award made by the rural land contract arbitration committee, requesting that the arbitration award be revoked, the People's Court shall inform the party to initiate an action with respect to the original dispute.

Article 5 The People's Court shall review the materials for an application for property preservation submitted by the rural land contract arbitration committee. If the materials conform to the provisions of the preceding article, the application shall be accepted; if the materials are incomplete or do not conform to the provisions, the People's Court shall notify the rural land contract arbitration committee of the contents that need to be supplemented.

Where the People's Court decides to accept the application, it shall serve the notice of acceptance on the party within three days and notify the rural land contract arbitration committee.

Article 6 After accepting an application for property preservation, the People's Court shall make a ruling within ten days. Where an extension is necessary due to special circumstances, with the approval of the president of the court, the period may be extended by five days.

After the People's Court accepts the application, where the circumstances are urgent, it must make a ruling within forty-eight hours; if it rules to adopt preservation measures, it shall immediately commence enforcement.

Article 7 Property preservation measures taken in arbitration of rural land contract disputes shall, after the party applying for preservation initiates an action according to law, automatically be converted into property preservation measures in litigation, and the provisions of Article 487 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China concerning the time limits for sealing, seizure, and freezing shall apply.

Article 10 Where a party, in accordance with Article 49 of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Mediation and Arbitration of Rural Land Contract Disputes, applies to the People's Court for enforcement of a mediation document or an arbitration award, and satisfies the conditions provided in Article 16 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Enforcement Work of the People's Courts (Trial Implementation), the People's Court shall accept and enforce it.

Article 11 Where a party initiates an action with the People's Court because it refuses to accept an arbitration award made by the rural land contract arbitration committee, the period for initiating prosecution shall be calculated from the day following the day on which it receives the award.

Article 12 After this Interpretation comes into force, first-instance and second-instance cases that have not yet been concluded by the People's Court shall be governed by the provisions of this Interpretation. For cases in which effective judgments or rulings have been made before this Interpretation comes into force, if a retrial is conducted according to law after this Interpretation comes into force, the provisions of this Interpretation shall not apply.
